levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «حدثني من سأله» is a first-person narrative with an unnamed asker (rule 11); the asker is kept as an unnamed link and a ruling is needed on him.
«- يعني الصادق عليه السلام -» is an editor's gloss: the surface «الصادق» is taken from it, because the Imam is the one asked who answers («قال: إن الكفر هو الشرك»), the last link (rules 5 and 6).
«أبي» (the compiler's shaykh) is a bare kinship word: relation.
